pack: Local Browser Agent - Codex Claude Build Pack
purpose: Build a local-first Chrome/Edge browser agent with a ChatGPT/Claude-style side panel, Express/TypeScript local backend, Ollama/Qwen orchestration, typed browser tools, continuous browser observation, and no database or persisted task/chat history.

implementation_targets.frontend: ../frontend/ - React + TypeScript + Vite + Manifest V3 browser extension
development: cd ../frontend && npm install && npm run dev
cd ../backend && npm install && npm run dev

non_negotiables: Ollama is the only enabled provider in V1, behind an LLM provider abstraction
Main Qwen model plus optional/automatic separate local vision-capable model
Typed browser tools only; LLM cannot execute arbitrary JavaScript/Playwright code
Fresh browser observation is mandatory after every meaningful action before another meaningful action
Browser driver abstraction contains ExtensionBrowserDriver and PlaywrightBrowserDriver
HTTP/WebSocket transport in MVP; Native Messaging architecture reserved for Phase 2
No persisted chat history, task history, screenshots, extracted page data, or LLM responses
Minimal settings/site permissions may use chrome.storage.local
Future provider secrets use OS-secure storage
Both frontend and backend must support npm run dev
Executable contract tests may not be skipped, deleted, or converted to todo
reference_behavior: Claude-like observe -> reason -> act -> automatically observe -> validate -> continue; do not claim implementation parity with proprietary Claude internals.
